name: Acuity RM Group Plc Ord
summary: Acuity RM Group Plc operates as a specialized firm delivering risk management software and associated services, with a principal focus on the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) market. Its core offering, branded as STREAM, is a dedicated GRC software platform designed to compile essential organizational data, thereby facilitating improved business decisions and overall operational management. The company was established on March 22, 1935, and its headquarters are located in London, United Kingdom.
